title: Really cut decorations
text: Really cut decorations. This has really cute decorations. With Covid 19 it was hard to find individualized wrapped candy to go with the saying. But if you don't mind that it was great. Everyone said "oh, that is so cute, I love this" so it was a big hit. It really helped fill out the table. I would buy this again.

product_metadata.title: 20PCS Graduation Decorations 2022 Party Supplies Set - Glitter Congrats Grad Banner Garland + 16 Label Tent Cards +1 Candy Bar Buffet Sign + 2 Table Centerpieces Decor Kit for Highschool Prek Graduate
features: Graduation party decorations 2022 - This graduation decorations kit includes 1 pc “congrats grad” banner+1 pc large candy bar party sign+16 pcs candy bar tent cards in two designs+2 pcs graduation table centerpieces. Total is 20 pcs. All are made of thick card stock.

Glitter congrats grad banner - It prints “CONGRATS GRAD”. This graduation garland comes pre-assembled and ready to hang up. Letters are roughly 9.7" tall and 7" wide, pre-strung along gold string (8.2 ft.).

Graduation candy bar party sign&tent cards- Large candy bar graduation party sign(9.8”*7.9”) prints “GRADUATION is SWEET” “Please take a TREAT”. You can place it in a frame(Not Included). 16 PCS graduation candy bar tent cards will give you some sweet ideas when you prepare the foods for your graduation party. Made of card stock. They are ready to place on your desktop and can stand well. Size: 4.7” x 3.2” (folded) and 4.7 “x 6.4”(unfolded).

Graduation party table centerpieces - They help you to create graduation touch to your graduation party tabletop. Star graduation table centerpiece is 7.7”*7.5”. Graduation cap table centerpiece is 6”*8.7”. Assembly needed.

2022 graduation party supplies - If you are about to throwing a graduation party, this kit is perfect for you to set up a a SWEET candy buffet and thank your guests for coming to celebrate! No matter who you are pre-k/primary school/middle school/high school/college/master/doctor graduate, if you love candy, you must be loved these candy bar buffet graduation party kit!
